notes.title: Next Fest Demo deactivation update.
notes.content:
Thanks, everyone, for playing the demo and sharing your valued feedback. 



This is a quick note to let you know that the Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest Next Fest demo will be deactivated on July 1st. 



If you haven't played it yet, then please do so before that time. 



We'll have a new demo closer to a release.
